vulnerabilities.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
vulnerabilities.summary:
Barracuda has disclosed details of two vulnerabilities affecting its products that, if chained together, could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to a susceptible device.

The vulnerabilities, a pre-authentication authorization bypass vulnerability and a command injection vulnerability, have been assigned the CVE identifiers CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS score: 9.3)

vulnerabilities.title: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors
vulnerabilities.summary:
A maximum-severity security flaw impacting Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices has come under active exploitation, VulnCheck has revealed.

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of missing authentication for a critical function that could be exploited by an unauthenticated remote attacker to run arbitrary code.

top_reads.title: Binance Reveals How Fake Job Interviews and AI Tool Abuse Led to $6.43 Billion Theft
top_reads.summary: Binance a révélé que le vol de 6,43 milliards de dollars s'est produit grâce à une campagne sophistiquée comprenant un envoi modifié de Homebrew et une escroquerie sociale sous couvert d'entretiens d'embauche.

top_reads.title: Chainstack Reports Production Systems Breach Exposing Customer Data and Password Hashes
top_reads.summary: Chainstack a fait savoir qu'une partie de son infrastructure a été compromise par une attaque utilisant l'intelligence artificielle, révélant des données clients et des hachages de mot de passe.

top_reads.title: Binance CEO says ‘months-long campaign’ led to $6.3 billion theft as N. Korea denies responsibility
top_reads.summary: Le PDG de Binance a déclaré que la fraude de 6,3 milliards de dollars s'est étalée sur plusieurs mois et impliquait des entretiens d'embauche faux. Pyongyang nie toute responsabilité.
